lines.text: Bank of America paid 0.51% on consumer deposits.
lines.say: Bank of America paid zero point five one percent on consumer deposits.

lines.text: On Oct 14, it reported $16.4 billion in net interest income for Q3 2026, up 8%.
lines.say: On October fourteenth, it reported sixteen point four billion dollars in net interest income for the third quarter, up eight percent.

lines.text: Net interest income: what a bank earns on loans and bonds, minus what it pays on deposits.
lines.say: Net interest income is what a bank earns on loans and bonds, minus what it pays you on deposits.

lines.text: The Fed's target range starts at 3.75%. BofA consumer deposits, checking included, averaged 0.51% in Q3 2026.
lines.say: After the September hike, the Fed's target range starts at three point seven five percent. Those deposits, checking included, averaged zero point five one percent.

lines.text: That's on $949 billion in average consumer deposits.
lines.say: That's on nine hundred forty-nine billion dollars in average consumer deposits.

lines.text: That rate was 0.61% in Q1 2025, fell to 0.48% in Q2 2026, then ticked up to 0.51%.
lines.say: That rate was zero point six one percent in early twenty twenty-five, fell to zero point four eight, then ticked up to zero point five one.

lines.text: Rates vary by bank and account, and the rate on any account is in its disclosures.

post.title: Bank of America paid 0.51% on consumer deposits
post.ig:
Bank of America paid an average 0.51% on consumer deposits, checking included.
On Oct 14, 2026, it reported $16.4B in Q3 net interest income, up 8%.
Its consumer deposits averaged $949B, with an average rate paid of 0.51% in Q3 2026 (all consumer deposits, not a savings offer).
The Fed's target range is 3.75%-4.00% after the September 2026 hike.
Sources: Bank of America Q3 2026 earnings release and presentation, 10-Q filings; Federal Reserve statement, Sept 16, 2026.
